result.real_lifecycle: probe -> prepare -> plan -> start -> second start refused -> streamed chat -> metrics (requests, tokens, TTFT) -> stop -> infer after stop refused -> stop idempotent -> VRAM back to within 50 MB of the pre-start value (asserted)

findings: vLLM's FlashInfer sampler JIT-compiles CUDA code at start-up and fails without nvcc (a worker PC will not have the CUDA toolkit): the adapter sets VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 by default
vLLM has no partial layer offload and no CPU mode here: Placement.gpu_layers == 0 is refused instead of silently running on the GPU
kv_type q8_0 is mapped to vLLM fp8, which is not the same format as ggml q8_0 (the plan notes say so); not measured for quality
not_covered: throughput or latency comparison with llama.cpp (no benchmark was run)
